Alan Greenspan’s [appearance](http://blogs.wsj.com/economics/2007/09/19/greenspan-cracks-a-joke-and-breaks-it-down/ "appearance") on Jon Stewart’s The Daily Show, where he answers the question, ‘Why do we have a Fed? Why do we have someone adjusting the rates if we’re a free-market society?’ 

Greenspan’s answer to that question has changed somewhat over the years.
